scope: post-hoc read-only CPU data/prediction/checkpoint audit; no inference or training

definitions.main_metric: single-list NDCG@5, five unique relevant targets, fixed idealDCG
definitions.train_popularity: retained training targets only; rank observed items by count, top10percent/head,bottom50percent/tail
definitions.temporal_validation: midpoint in wall-clock time, exploratory and already used by original selection
definitions.cold: any target absent from retained training histories+targets

cold_mix_decomposition.note: Exact descriptive decomposition, not causal evidence

item_decomposition.note: Exact additive decomposition of item DCG contribution, no causal attribution; per-item estimates may be sparse

limitations: Post-hoc examination of previously seen validation/test labels; no test-based parameter selection.
Only one training seed; conditional user bootstrap excludes checkpoint-selection uncertainty.
No H0-R20 or alternative H1 checkpoint test predictions; cannot separate training-epoch effect with current tests.
R20 vs R35 code collapse does not causally explain R20 best validation/test reversal.
